derived_from: 50 ranked posts, LinkedIn aggregate analytics 2025-09-03 to 2026-09-02

publish_time_hypothesis.note: No posting times exist in the analytics export. Treat as an A/B to run, not a settled fact.

objective.rationale: Accepted connection requests are subtracted before measuring. Baseline organic gain is about 12 per month; the 2026-05-25 breakout produced 198 in one month.
objective.note: Conversion is flat across broad and niche reach, so organic follower growth is a function of impressions. Breakouts are the only mechanism that has moved it.

cadence.consecutive_day_evidence: Median impressions after a 0-1 day gap: 1057. After a 5+ day gap: 996. No penalty observed, so a strong post does not buy a rest day.

Monday.evidence: The 2026-05-25 breakout (227,264 impressions, 684 engagements) published on a Monday.

Tuesday.evidence: Second-highest average reach and only 3 posts published all year. Most under-used slot.

Wednesday.evidence: Highest average reach of any day. 2026-07-15 build post: 10,170 impressions, 86 engagements.

Thursday.evidence: Weakest day on both measures, so nothing is at risk in converting it to a second broad attempt.

Friday.evidence: Second-highest average reach, previously spent on humour. Humour posts scored 1, 2 and 2 engagements - the three worst results in the set.

Sunday.evidence: Lowest reach, highest engagement total of any day (142 excluding the breakout). The niche audience shows up on Sunday.
